channel.title: ScreenSort
channel.description: Updates for ScreenSort, the on-device screenshot organizer and namer for macOS.

item.title: ScreenSort 1.0
item.description:
• Initial release of ScreenSort for macOS.
  • Watches your screenshot folder and automatically renames new screenshots using on-device Vision and Apple Intelligence.
  • Routes screenshots into category subfolders with one-click Undo, Quick Look, and drag-to-attach from the post-rename notification and menu bar list.
  • Automatic updates powered by Sparkle 2 and 14-day free trial with one-time license activation.
